verdict.rationale: Riveter lets developers configure custom data-extraction workflows (enrichments, scrapes, quick_search) via prompts or structured specs and run them via API/SDK without managing servers (riveter-docs-1,2,3,11,26), which covers the 'no infrastructure' half of the story. However, there is no evidence of a true custom-script/code deployment model (e.g., writing and uploading arbitrary scraping logic that Riveter executes as a serverless function) — the platform is config/prompt driven rather than script-authoring, and OpenAPI/llms.txt probes even 404 (riveter-probe-1, riveter-probe-2). Missing for 10: evidence of writing/uploading custom code (not just prompts/specs), a documented script execution/sandbox environment, and independent confirmation of this deployment model.
